exposure: Bleeding group (excessive intra-operative blood loss ≥200ml during dilation and suction evacuation)
outcome: Excessive intra-operative haemorrhage during evacuation operation for CSP
finding: Gestational age, serum β-hCG, size of gestational sac, thickness of myometrial layer and peritrophoblastic perfusion were found to be associated with excessive intra-operative haemorrhage during suction evacuation of CSP.
